rule_applied: The slot rule from the skill (merge-and-vault-schema.md): PASS 1 exact title after unescaping + dash/whitespace normalisation; PASS 2 ordinal slot, only if unclaimed after PASS 1 and unique in BOTH directions; PASS 3 no companion, recorded under the mechanism that caused it. TWO independent joins were run - call<->ORIGINAL pdf and call<->AI SUMMARY - because they are different relationships.
similarity_role: DIAGNOSTIC CROSS-CHECK ONLY. It never joins anything. It is computed to count how many decisions it WOULD have got wrong.

THE_EMPIRICAL_CASE_FOR_THE_RULE.statement: Token-overlap similarity at a 0.50 floor would have paired 59 call/document pairs that the slot rule refuses. Those 59 are not hypothetical: each is a real near-collision in a real folder.
THE_EMPIRICAL_CASE_FOR_THE_RULE.consequence: The skill's position that this function is 'actively wrong' here, and that 'no threshold tuning would repair it', is reproduced on this corpus. It earns its keep on measurement, not assertion.
THE_EMPIRICAL_CASE_FOR_THE_RULE.counterfactual_cost: Adopting similarity would also have silently absorbed the 5 genuinely-substantive differences listed below - which require a human decision, not a score.

orphan_summary_defects_grouped.11_CALL_TYPE_PREFIX_DIFFERS: The SUMMARY files say 'NHB+ Coaching Call' where the MEDIA files say 'NHB Coaching Call' (and 'NHB+' vs 'NHB' theory-call variants). This is a SYSTEMATIC divergence between two file families, not 11 independent defects. It is one decision, not eleven.
orphan_summary_defects_grouped.4_DATE_ZERO_PADDING: Summary '12-05-2024' vs media '12-5-2024'. Identical date, different padding.
orphan_summary_defects_grouped.1_BOX_DRAWING_DASH: Some MEDIA filenames use box-drawing U+2500 where the SUMMARY uses ASCII '-'. Similarity 0.969, exact match fails purely on the dash character.
orphan_summary_defects_grouped.5_SUBSTANTIVE: See below - these need a human decision and MUST NOT be auto-paired.

bugs_found_and_fixed_while_building_this: The classifier applied the AI-suffix regex to the RAW filename including '.pdf', while the regex is anchored at end-of-string. Result: the summary list was silently EMPTY for every folder, and the join reported 'no summary anywhere' while 51 summaries existed. A false zero of exactly the kind this skill exists to catch.
An aggregator emitted a clean zero because a '@@' sentinel left a leading '@' on every JSON line, so all rows failed to parse. Same lesson: zero-evaluated is a failure, not a result.
Console cp1252 encoding cannot print the box-drawing characters that appear in real MEGA filenames.
